title.zh: 架构树对齐 11 月批次：战备装载、局内检查点、办事任务校验器
title.en: Architecture sync: battle loadout, run checkpoint and office-task verifier

intent.zh: 把 2026-11-07 之后的 10 个提交带来的新增功能（战备装载与携带物资、局内检查点与恢复、办事任务链路）纳入架构树；同时修复美术目录改名与大文件指纹上限造成的 8 条证据缺失，并把漂移模块的指纹重算到当前 HEAD。
intent.en: Fold the features added by the 10 commits since 2026-11-07 (battle loadout and carry-over items, in-run checkpoint and recovery, office-task chain) into the module tree; repair the 8 broken evidence entries caused by the art directory rename and the large-file fingerprint limit; recompute drifted fingerprints against the current HEAD.

acceptance: 新建 battle-prep / run-checkpoint / office-task-tool 三个模块进入树并 active
encounter、presenter.gameplay-meta、view.gameplay.{dispatch,run-menu,inventory-wheel}、assets.{ui-prefabs,ui-sprites}、scenes.test-scene 的 source 与 API 覆盖本轮新增文件
w5-gameplay / framework.save / editor-tools 三层布局纳入新成员
build 与 render 成功产出 normify.html
